item.title: MemSilicon Tapes Out MountTai 2026, a 28nm 1Gb RRAM Chip With One Transistor per Four Cells
item.description: MemSilicon says MountTai 2026 is the first high-density 1T4R RRAM chip at gigabit scale: 1Gb on 28nm CMOS, 30Mb/mm2 density, under 20ns access and on-chip ECC. Validation is underway.

item.title: Dobot Launches VEGA 7, a Seven-Axis Force-Controlled Arm for Embodied AI With 50,000-Hour MTBF
item.description: Dobot's VEGA 7 has torque sensors and brakes in every joint, 0.15N force control accuracy, a 7kg payload and 725mm reach, aimed at wheeled dual-arm robots and embodied AI work.

item.title: PHANES AI Launches SeePhys Hub, a Wearable Kit That Records Vision, Touch and Full-Body Motion
item.description: PHANES AI's SeePhys Hub pairs a four-camera headband with wrist, waist and leg trackers and tactile gloves, capturing human motion and touch data for training robots.
